# codex

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.sh from modules/components/codex; do not edit. -->

The Codex CLI (`codex`), its agent rules link, its configuration file as a settings target, its legacy skill root and, optionally, Codex plugins.

The component lives in [`modules/components/codex`](../../modules/components/codex/):

- [README.md](../../modules/components/codex/README.md): what it installs, its options and its settings.
- [maintenance.md](../../modules/components/codex/maintenance.md): its pins and how `dotsteward-update` refreshes them.
- [default.nix](../../modules/components/codex/default.nix): the Home Manager module that fills the component contract.
- [seed.json](../../modules/components/codex/seed.json): the flake inputs and lock entries an instance starts with when it enables the component.

See the [catalog](../catalog.md) for the other components.
